assessment.nobel_worthiness: Densely patterned, visionary Romanian prose (Blinding, Solenoid) turns memory, the body and dream into a large metaphysical project. The voice is highly recognisable and the formal ambition is sustained across long, architecturally complex books. The case is strong on distinctiveness of voice and imaginative depth. The concern is whether the later volumes keep the same intensity.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation would cover the Romanian-language novelistic project and its visionary treatment of consciousness and memory. Poetry is part of the record, but the case rests chiefly on the major prose.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a coherent, accumulating body of work. His strongest claims appear to rest on works already established, so the timing is reasonable.
uncertainties: Judgement depends on translations of very stylised Romanian prose; how well the density and musicality of the original carry over is uncertain.
I have not independently verified the whole corpus, and my coverage of the poetry and earlier work is incomplete.
The scale and self-referentiality of the late works may blur the distinctness of individual books.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Compressed, rhythmically exacting French prose (Small Lives, The Eleven) turns obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry. The voice is unmistakable and the language is worked with great precision. The achievement is formally intense, though narrow in volume.
assessment.attribution: A citation would honour a concentrated body of short and mid-length prose fiction that reinvents the imagined biography. It names one writer and one distinctive literary method.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is small but consistent in quality. The question is whether its breadth meets the 'whole life' standard as well as larger bodies of work do.
uncertainties: The prose depends heavily on syntax and register, so translation loss is likely to be significant.
The limited volume of work raises the question of breadth and range.
My knowledge of the later works is thinner than my knowledge of the best-known ones.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major reshaping of modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with the inherited tradition (Songs of Mihyar the Damascene, A Time Between Ashes and Roses). He is also an influential essayist and critic of tradition. The formal and linguistic significance is very large.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover poetic renewal of the Arabic tradition and the accompanying critical thought. Poetry and essays are the main genres, so the scope is clear.
assessment.maturity: Many decades of work and a long-established influence. The achievement is mature, and the case is not a question of timing.
uncertainties: Poetry in Arabic is hard to judge through translation. The sound, prosody and allusive depth are the most vulnerable.
Part of the significance is historical and critical influence, which has to be separated from the quality of individual poems.
I have not independently verified the full corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative, morally attentive prose (Housekeeping, Gilead) with an unmistakable voice that joins theology, family and American history. The writing is stylistically controlled and intellectually serious. The novel output is modest, balanced by influential essays.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover contemplative fiction and essays on faith, moral interiority and the American inheritance. It names one author and a clear method.
assessment.maturity: The late career is consistent with the early work. The main question is whether the overall output is large and varied enough.
uncertainties: The number of novels is small, so the sustained-breadth criterion is less clear.
English-language prose of this register is well served by the original, so translation is less of a concern; my knowledge of the essays is secondary to the fiction.
The theological framework may constrain range, and I cannot judge this beyond the best-known books.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences (Purgatory, Anteparadise) and landscape-scale interventions turn suffering into collective memorial form. The formal ambition is great and the ethical-historical weight is real. The verbal quality on the page is the main thing to be assessed apart from the conceptual scope.
assessment.attribution: A citation would honour Spanish-language poetry as witness to dictatorship and historical trauma. The scope is narrow in genre but strong in vision.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a consistent project. The work is established.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation, plus works whose meaning depends on scale and physical context, is hard to assess from texts alone.
The weight of historical-political significance should not substitute for judgement of the verse itself.
I have not independently verified the full range of the output.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large polyphonic novels (Carpentaria, The Swan Book) reshape the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. The voice is ambitious and distinctive, and the imaginative reach is broad. Quality across her full body of work is hard to judge, since the major fiction is limited in number.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover English-language fiction that draws on Aboriginal storytelling and political imagination. One writer is named, with a clear formal contribution.
assessment.maturity: A significant body of work, but a smaller novelistic corpus than some other candidates. The case may rest on the recent maturity of her work.
uncertainties: The novel count is small and the long-term durability is uncertain.
The dense, collective narrative form may depend on cultural context that I cannot fully assess.
I have not independently verified the nonfiction or later works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike, anti-realist fiction that destabilises psychology, space and causality. The voice is singular and the formal commitment is consistent over decades. The question is whether the imaginative depth develops or repeats across a large body of work.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover experimental Chinese-language fiction with a distinctive dream logic. The scope is clear and singular.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a very consistent method. The consistency counts toward distinctiveness, though it may also limit range.
uncertainties: I am reliant on translated selections, and the proportion of her output available in translation is uncertain.
The method's repetition across books makes it difficult to assess development.
My ability to judge the Chinese-language prose directly is limited.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward fiction (The Plains, Border Districts) builds distinctive systems of landscape, memory and mental images. The voice is very particular, and the formal discipline is high. Its narrow range is both its strength and a limit.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover English-language fiction that makes the workings of imagination and memory the subject. One writer, a clear method.
assessment.maturity: A long career whose late work extends the same project. The coherence is evident, though the small scale of the work may limit its wider significance.
uncertainties: The narrow thematic range may limit significance relative to broader oeuvres.
I have not independently verified the whole corpus, and my knowledge of the later books is less secure.
The reception beyond English-language readers is uncertain, though the prose is available in the original.
